thesis: The episode introduces Jake Walthour, the co-founder and CEO of Blueprint Capital Advisors, who details his non-traditional entry into Wall Street in 1990 without family connections or elite schooling. He describes the stark cultural differences between his background and the wealthy, Ivy League peers in his analyst training program, noting that while the environment was friendly, he was the only person from a diversity program in his cohort.
